atomic_facts.fact: Wirecard AG filed for insolvency on 25 June 2020.
The insolvency filing followed revelations that €1.9 billion was missing.
The fact that the €1.9 billion was missing indicates that trustees did not genuinely confirm the escrow cash.
EY declared that Wirecard engaged in fraud and provided 'false confirmations and statements with regard to escrow accounts'.
Direct bank confirmation could not be found on the authenticity of the documents received to support the evidence of €1.9bn in cash.
EY checked directly with the respective banks in the Philippines whether the €1.9 billion of escrow cash was really there and found it was not.
On 16 June 2020, EY informed Wirecard that the account balances Wirecard had submitted were forged.
The false confirmations and the absence of any bank confirmation show there was no genuine trustee confirmation of the escrow cash.
